sources.title: Wikipedia: Cleopatra
sources.description: Pharaoh of Egypt from 51 to 30 BC

notes.text: Cleopatra VII Thea Philopator was Queen of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt from 51 to 30 BC, and the last active Hellenistic pharaoh.
Cleopatra's first language was Koine Greek, and she is the only Ptolemaic ruler known to have learned the Egyptian language, among several others.
Cleopatra is remembered as a politician connected with Egypt.
Cleopatra's recorded life dates place this profile around -69--30.
Cleopatra is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
